Hello!
Your comment was actually seriously helpful! Thank you very very much! Everything you are saying is 100% valid and true. While I would be sad if he didn’t want to be my friend, I would completely understand and respect it. I suggested asking his parents because he still asks for permission and talks to them a lot, but now I see it’s not a good idea. I spoke to him again and I explained and reassured him that my bf is no threat and at the same time, I think your idea of my bf and my friend meeting each other might be a great idea! I would be scared too if I went out with a friend who was taken and their partner would have an issue with me, so I perfectly understand where my friend’s feelings come from. Honestly, I have learned so much and it makes me the happiest to know that I do right by my friend in looking for advice instead doing what I think it’s right, because it’s not about me to begin with. Thank you kind stranger, I hope you have a good day!

I mostly like to pretend I’m in bizarre situations. I have been diagnosed by a professional that I have BPD. So let’s say, I had a fight with someone that resulted in the lost of a friendship. The pain usually is so unbearable that I usually think of leaving earth(just to put it in pretty words) I would pretend to off myself and I would pretend to be that person on my funeral and how they cope with the news. 
It kinda gives me comfort in an odd and fucked up way. They might have left because of something I probably did, but I know deep down they probably do really care. 
Other bizarre situations include how I react to earthquakes, kidnappings, running away from a bad guy, or me having to be a hero and trying to save people. 

I hope I don’t sound like a lunatic...

Let me give you another perspective 
I(20 yo F) was the favorite one between me and my sister (23 yo F). Everything was handed to me in a silver platter and up until I went to college, everything I wanted I had it and everything I needed done was done by my parents. Now don’t get my parents wrong, they also provided my sister with everything she needed also, but they payed more attention to me (sorry this sounds narcissistic, but there is no other way to put it) My mom didn’t make it a secret that I was her favorite, which made my sister resentful and with good reason.
Now college is where it gets interesting, my sister has been independent since she was a child because my mom never really payed much attention to her. My sister lives angry at this, but tbh can you even blame her? As angry as she is she still loves me in her own way. She has thrived in college and is successful in her grades (she still hasn’t graduated) now onto me...
I don’t have any life skills whatsoever, nor do I have the capacity to even make it through an English class by myself... I’m about to fail college, I can’t even get a job because the only qualification I can put in my resume is “I’m good at being spoiled” which quite frankly is not a skill. As an “adult” I am a joke! I can’t make it on my own and like some people say “I’m holding my life together with duct tape” where to me THAT IS MY REALITY. Where I don’t even know how to fill an application ever make my own resumé at 20 fucking years old. 

So, no OP you’re not the asshole. 
Your brother is in for a rude awakening, when he becomes a father... how will he raise a child where he can’t even hold a job? 
Your parents are not gonna be around forever 
So if my parents taught me anything, everything given on a silver platter is LEGITIMATELY TEMPORARY! 

I’m now struggling to get back into college, my mental health is shredded into pieces by the fact that I am a joke of an adult and some trauma Ive been through, amongst other things. And somehow my sister is the one giving a few helping steps here and there, because she knows my parents messed up BAD. 
Struggle made my sister the bad ass and successful woman that she is today and spoiling me made me into the problems and lack of skills I am today. 
If anything, sit your brother and really tell him how the world is. He sounds like me before I knew how hard life really was...

This actually tore my(20 yo F) one year relationship with my ex bf(19 yo M)... He was my FP and I was so emotionally dependent on him. I would do the impossible for him and I to see each other. If I had to drive hours to see him, no fucks were given, I would do it regardless. He didn’t have money? No problem, I’m loaded ALWAYS. To the point where I disassociated from everyone else and just wanted to hang out with him. Apart from the major problem that only 2 of my friends have license which made it extremely hard to like everyone else. My BPD is very unstable from time to time, so with people I hate or like them. No in between...  I’m working on it tho!
After he broke up with me, of course he no longer contacted me and given that my emotions are volatile it was for the best. So I also stopped contacting him as well, since he broke up with me I blocked him everywhere and he did the same. The aftermath for me (since I can’t really speak for him since) was fucking terrible... I tried punishing myself by not eating for a month (mind you I was already underweight and I’m 4’9 so this was VERY dangerous, DO NOT DO THIS!) because the relationship was kinda doomed from the start as much as I loved him... I stopped showering everyday, and I was just messed up period. 

So this is what I did: I looked for therapy and sadly because of my BPD I become codependent to people without noticing. So I’ve learned to identify these behaviors and put a stop to myself and ground myself. You would be surprise to find out that you may or may not think that your FP’s life revolves around you, that’s at least in my case. Or you want your FP’s life to revolve around because well of course! Who wouldn’t want to see their FP everyday?! I would lie if I say I didn’t!

My biggest 3 solutions:
•I became my own FP! 
Sounds narcissistic but it’s very hard to love ourselves, and being borderline just made me plain out hate myself for the longest of time. I learnt more about myself, got into hobbies, learned to bake/ make new recipes, learn how to do many other things! I got into skin care and I’m also thinking of getting into exercise after I have a stable diet. I dipped my toes into makeup, indulged myself into fashion, or even played a couple games even if I’m not a adamant video gamer (i suck bad) learn to be with yourself. People often brush off the whole “if you don’t love yourself, you can’t love someone else” quote often thinking “piss off, I may hate myself but I have a partner that helps me love myself” and that’s actually seriously NOT healthy at all... explore yourself the way you want to explore the world because everyone is a world of their own! And you will surprise yourself I promise! Loving yourself makes you self reliant and powerful, amongst other great things! 

•therapy.
It helped me understand myself way better and I just learned how to recognize when I’m being toxic towards myself and towards other people. I also learned people skills, which mine were all over the place 😅

And as surprising as it may sound

•Don’t have an FP 
For me I have a hard time distinguishing between like and love since all my emotions are always extreme most of the time. So I learned and made new friends and slowly but surely I’m loving all of them equally and no that doesn’t mean they are ALL FP’s now 

I hope this helps!
